truthQuery: run: t_order_items extend { join_one: t_products on product_id = t_products.product_id } extend { dimension: line_margin is sale_price - t_products.cost, line_markdown is t_products.retail_price - sale_price } -> { group_by: brand is t_products.brand; aggregate: margin_rate is line_margin.sum() / sale_price.sum(); order_by: margin_rate desc; limit: 1 }
verifyQuery: run: t_order_items extend { join_one: t_products on product_id = t_products.product_id } extend { dimension: line_margin is sale_price - t_products.cost, line_markdown is t_products.retail_price - sale_price } -> { where: t_products.brand = 'Harbor'; aggregate: margin_rate is line_margin.sum() / sale_price.sum() }
